Module sudoku
Package sudoku.controller

Class SudokuController

java.lang.Object
sudoku.controller.SudokuController
public class SudokuController extends Object
Controller of the Sudoku window. It receives the events of the player (keyboard, mouse and buttons), asks the game what to do, and updates what the window shows. It has no Sudoku rules: those are in the model.
